text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Birthday wishes from the
Mejiros?! Is this
what they call a birthday
bonus?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank Palmer. She asked that we
celebrate her
friend's special day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Palmer was telling us about how much
she's
learned since meeting you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We hope you'll continue to be good
friends with
our Palmer—and us.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
OMG Palmer really is doing the most!
But I'm so
glad I met her too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And you guys too, we besties
now—waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm jealous of your energy.
Waheeey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I feel the Mejiros' dignified image
crumbling as we
speak...
